title: CTV Advertising That Reaches the Right Rooms | Qujam

facts.fact: Qujam's self-serve platform lets advertisers launch CTV campaigns with no daily minimums, according to the vendor's own page.
facts.quote: On a self-serve platform like Qujam, advertisers can launch campaigns with no daily minimums, swap out creative on the fly, and adjust targeting in real time.

facts.fact: The vendor states that some enterprise ad-tech platforms (Simpli.fi) and managed-service agencies (Propellant Media) still enforce high monthly minimums for CTV access; this is the vendor's own claim, with no dollar figure given.
facts.quote: While some enterprise ad-tech platforms like Simpli.fi or managed-service agencies like Propellant Media still enforce high monthly minimums for CTV access

facts.fact: The page cites a 15-second or 30-second video ad as the standard length for a streaming TV spot.
facts.quote: A 15- or 30-second video ad on a television screen creates a very different viewing environment than a small display ad beside an article.

facts.fact: Traditional broadcast TV buys rely on broad geographic markets, often called DMAs, and demographic estimates.
facts.quote: Traditional broadcast TV relies on broad geographic markets (often called DMAs) and demographic estimates.

facts.fact: The page defines Connected TV (CTV) as television content watched through an internet-connected device.
facts.quote: Connected TV, or CTV, refers to television content watched through an internet-connected device.

facts.fact: Qujam's CTV advertising is priced on CPM, meaning cost per thousand impressions.
facts.quote: CTV is priced on CPM, meaning cost per thousand impressions.

facts.fact: According to Qujam, there is no daily spend minimum for its CTV advertising, which gives smaller advertisers room to test.
facts.quote: No daily spend minimum gives smaller advertisers room to test thoughtfully.

facts.fact: Qujam states that enterprise platforms such as Simpli.fi and managed agencies such as Propellant Media require high minimums (a vendor claim about competitors, not independently verified).
facts.quote: Unlike enterprise platforms (Simpli.fi) or managed agencies (Propellant Media) that require high minimums and slow down execution

facts.fact: Qujam's key takeaways state that self-serve platforms allow businesses to launch CTV campaigns with no daily minimums.
facts.quote: self-serve platforms allow businesses to launch CTV campaigns with direct control and no daily minimums.

facts.fact: Qujam describes its CTV targeting for local businesses as serving ads to households that recently visited high-intent physical locations, using geofencing.
facts.quote: local businesses can use geofencing to serve CTV ads strictly to households that recently visited high-intent physical locations

facts.fact: Qujam states that the ideal CTV frequency depends on campaign duration, audience size, creative strength, and how urgent the offer is.
facts.quote: The ideal level depends on campaign duration, audience size, creative strength, and how urgent the offer is.

facts.fact: Qujam says video completion rate is a useful delivery metric but does not measure whether a campaign drove business.
facts.quote: It is a useful delivery metric, not the finish line.
